name: memorize-it
description: Capture the conclusion of a prompting/working session as structured context in git commits (why, what, tried, next, concerns) and recall it later so future sessions and reviewers understand why decisions were made. Squash-and-merge aware, with tiered recall (commit body → PR/MR description → individual PR commits). Commit convention, issue-key derivation, and platform mechanics are configured via a companion rules file in your project.
